note: Golem Nguyen To ban 3 (giu tao hinh 05-golem-v2): 3 tam tranh AI cua nguoi dung, PNG trong suot that (key alpha; giu nguyen, chi cat + can chan + co gian). scale: hang dam ve nho hon hang di ~6%, tam lua-bang ~6%, tam set-trieu hoi ~12% (chong hinh + khop ngoc nguc). Moc ngang: 'body' cho di (than dung yen, chan buoc), 'heel' cho dam / gong / phun / don set; anchorX cho cuon tron (troi len) va tan ra dong da. Diem gan: handN = nam dam dung nham (lua quanh tay luc gong Nong Lua) · handF = nam dam phia truoc (vet dam lua khi lao, set giat) · mouth = mieng (hit khi lanh, phun bao tuyet) · core = ngoc nguc (set troi giang).
